name: schema-header-malformed-attribute
description: A schema header contains a malformed or unknown attribute.
common_causes: Using unknown or invalid attributes in schema header
Missing required header attributes for library schemas
explanation: Schema headers must contain only valid attributes as defined in the HED specification. Unknown attributes indicate potential schema structure problems or specification violations.
correction_strategy: Remove unknown attributes and ensure proper header format
correction_patterns: Verify header syntax matches format specification
fix_instructions: 1. Identify unknown or invalid attributes in header
5. Ensure library schema requirements are met
validation_hints: Check against valid HED header attribute list
Verify attribute spelling and case sensitivity
Ensure library schemas include required attributes

name: schema-header-unknown-attribute
description: An unknown attribute was found in the schema header.

name: schema-header-unmerged-value-variants
description: The unmerged header attribute value is case-insensitive, and unmerged="false" is equivalent to omitting the attribute (the schema is merged).
common_causes: Assuming the unmerged attribute value is case-sensitive
Rejecting unmerged="false" instead of treating the schema as merged
explanation: The value of the unmerged header attribute is case-insensitive: unmerged="True" and unmerged="TRUE" mean the same as unmerged="true". A schema with unmerged="false" is a merged schema, exactly as if the attribute were omitted.
correction_strategy: Treat the unmerged value case-insensitively and treat false as merged

correction_examples.wrong: Rejecting HED version="1.0.0" library="testconflict" withStandard="8.4.0" unmerged="TRUE"
correction_examples.correct: Accept it; the value is case-insensitive
correction_examples.explanation: true, True, and TRUE are equivalent values

correction_examples.wrong: Treating unmerged="false" as an unmerged schema
correction_examples.correct: Treat unmerged="false" as a merged schema
correction_examples.explanation: If the value is false the attribute should be omitted, but its presence still means merged

correction_patterns: Interpret a false value as merged
fix_instructions: 1. Parse the unmerged attribute value case-insensitively
2. Treat a false value exactly like an absent attribute
3. Load the standard schema partner only for unmerged schemas
validation_hints: Check header parsing against 3.1.2.2. Merged vs unmerged
